structural_findings: Forward-horizon shortage, not source scarcity: widening lookback from 21d to 42d (corrected A1+A2) added 150 dated items — all rejected for negative or sub-lag horizons; eligible buckets unchanged at 14/0/0 (data-backed).

Horizon = voting period minus opening age; a wider opening window increases opening age and therefore decreases horizon — EXTEND_LOOKBACK cannot create MEDIUM/LONG eligibility for governance-vote observables.
WAIT_AND_RERUN at the unchanged frozen cutoff re-collects short-period governance votes while near-end items expire; it cannot repair a forward-horizon design mismatch.

Only governance votes (A1/A2) carry source-native FUTURE dates under v0.2; with A2 now measured (10 active governors, 46 additional 21d items), MEDIUM and LONG remain empty; all other registered classes expose historical timestamps and are ineligible under Step 3 item 2.
Therefore exact 5/5/5 is structurally unsatisfiable by any lawful v0.2 run over the registered source classes — a methodology-design miss.
